Set a long-term goal for the Agent session; the AI works toward it each turn (Agent sessions only)

Agent session goal (Agent sessions only):

/goal <goal>
 Set the goal and inject it into each turn's context; the AI works toward it.
/goal
 Show the current goal.
/goal done
 Mark the goal complete and clear it.
/goal clear
 Cancel and clear the goal.

The goal stays active across turns until completed or cleared; you can also send any message to have the AI continue working on it.
Spec-driven development: draft a spec, then /spec approve and implement it (Agent sessions only)

Agent spec task (Agent sessions only):

/spec <feature>
 Start a spec task; the AI immediately drafts the spec and submits it for confirmation.
/spec
 Show the current spec task status.
/spec approve
 Approve the spec; the AI immediately implements it item by item with todo_write.
/spec done
 Mark complete and remove (the spec document is kept).
/spec clear
 Cancel the spec task (the spec document is kept).

The spec is saved to the session workspace as specs/<feature>/spec.md by default.
In Agent sessions you can use `/yolo` to skip normal command authorization for the current session; high-risk actions are still blocked.

Agent session goal and spec commands (long-press a command for the full usage):

/goal <goal>: set the goal and inject it into each turn's context
/goal: show · /goal done: complete and clear · /goal clear: cancel

/spec <feature>: start a spec task; the AI immediately drafts the spec
/spec: show status · /spec approve: approve and implement · /spec done: complete and remove · /spec clear: cancel
Type `/help` to see the available local commands.
